title: Sparse Access Journeys Map and Audit Summarizer
creator: Maya Patel
description: Design a compact, action-first audit summarizer and sparse access journey map for the Redwood Console that surfaces high-signal permission changes, anomalous accesses, and rollout-related regressions across orgs and workspaces. The feature should minimize cognitive load for SREs, security reviewers, and product owners by grouping low-frequency events into contextual buckets, showing estimated cost impact, and providing one-click remediation or rollback actions tied to rollout policies.
goal: Reduce time-to-detection and mean-time-to-remediation for critical permission regressions and costly rollout mistakes by presenting a condensed, prioritized view of access events linked to cost and rollout metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype with a sparse journey map showing clustered access events for an example workspace
Audit summarizer card shows top 3 high-priority events with cost delta and suggested remediation
One-click actions in the prototype call out required backend hooks (rollback, revoke, start access-review) and show confirmation flows
Design includes accessibility and microcopy for security-conscious language
Design passes stakeholder review and handoff checklist for engineering implementation
